en-US.name: Eye Rest
en-US.summary: Schedules 20-20-20 eye breaks during a 90-minute play session.
en-US.description: Eye Rest helps children take regular screen breaks. It announces a 30-second distance-viewing break after each 20-minute play period and ends after 90 minutes.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Eye Rest to start
Alexa, ask Eye Rest to cancel my session

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Enable Reminders permission. Open Eye Rest and answer yes. Confirm nine reminders are created relative to the start time. Use cancel eye rest to remove them.
